criterion: K >= ceil(LP*); a feasible dual of mass > r-1 proves K = r
restriction: none; the dual support carries non-binary active prefixes
centre_classes_note: ALL (active-prefix type, free weight) classes, 3^2 x 18. Not the 2^2 binary-prefix classes: this dual has non-binary support, so the binary reduction is unavailable and was not used.
rounding: solver masses rounded DOWN to denominator 1000000 (preserves feasibility), then scaled by the exact maximum load 1079999/1000000 so the released dual is feasible everywhere with maximum ball mass exactly 1
DO_NOT_READ_THE_MASS_AS_A_MEASUREMENT: exact_total_mass is a safe LOWER bound on tau*, not tau* itself: masses were rounded down and the column set offered to the LP was capped, both of which can only weaken it. ceil of it is what proves K = r.
